verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a hosted search service with official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics collection or any opt-out control. Encryption, a BAA and PrivateLink are adjacent security features and are not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
